steps.content: Bureau Corridor

A hush finally settles over the Bureau's corridor after a long day of activity. As your work is wrapping up, you exhale the day's tension and set your sights on the Recreation Area for some well-earned rest.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Finally managed to carve out a few days off. Now, how to spend them... Something low-key? A nature escape? Honestly, just crashing at home for three days straight sounds like a solid recharge plan. I'm definitely keeping that on the table.
At that moment, a soft voice curls around the corner at the corridor's end, almost as if it has heard your unspoken thoughts and is answering back.

Spring is in full bloom. Why not let your heart take a little trip? Good evening, dear listeners, and welcome to your personal late-night sanctuary. With the holidays upon us, have you made any travel plans yet?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hm?

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Perhaps a quiet stroll through the city streets, letting the rhythm of everyday life wash over you. Or a walk through the hills, where you can breathe in the scent of fresh earth and open air. Or maybe just nestling in at home with your loved ones. All of them are beautiful ways to slow down and savor a rare, unhurried moment.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Our new feature, "Come Away With Me," has been blessed with so many heartfelt letters from devoted listeners. You've shared such thoughtful tips and hidden gems with us. Today, I'd love to introduce a nature spot that truly deserves a place on your list.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: This little treasure sits just on the city's edge. It's not only a breathtaking garden in its own right, but also the real-life inspiration behind The Enchanted Garden, the illustrated fairy tale book that's taken Eastside by storm.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: I'm sure many of you have already read the book. Whether you fell in love with the charming little animals, the winding paths, the wildflowers, or those shafts of light dancing through the leaves, you'll find every last detail waiting for you here, alive and real.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: So... that's the end of it. What do you all think?
Eleven lowers the script with a touch of reluctance, her read-through complete, and turns her gaze to the little ones she's roped in as test listeners for her new feature.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: That was sooo good! Bravo!!!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Whoa! Eleven, you sound so pretty and, like, super fancy! Hey, can you write my essay for tomorrow's exam? If I have to copy off EMP, I'm totally screwed...

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Your voice is gentle. It pulls you in... I think your listeners will really like it.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: It was lovely. Though... does DisCity actually have a place like that? Since I arrived, I've only ever seen the urban landscape. Nothing quite like what you described.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Oh, you asked the right person! This picture book went crazy viral online, and the location totally blew up with it! So many people have already been there. Sooo... what if we sneak out tomorrow and go check it out ourselves?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: We can't... There's an exam at the Syndicate Academy tomorrow, and I need to make sure Hella studies. If she fails again, they'll call Chief in. We shouldn't make more trouble for Chief.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ugh, it's just a dumb exam! I get the same grade no matter what anyway! You know who I am? I'm the mighty Hella! You really think some stupid test can hold me down? I'm skipping it, end of sto—OW!

Her grand declaration barely out of her mouth, a flick lands squarely on her forehead. Hella winces from the sting and looks up, only to find the culprit—you—staring back at her with a perfectly blank expression.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Slacking off on your studies and now you want to skip exams too?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I-I just wanna go out and do something fun, okay?! The weather's so nice outside. Of course I wanna go see it!
At the sight of the group tumbling into a mess of laughter, a giggle escapes Hypa despite herself, and she glances over at Eleven.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: And what about you? If you really had the chance, would you want to go see it?

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: ...I would. Talking about these places on air, sharing them with everyone, but never having seen them with my own eyes... I always worry the feeling behind the words isn't quite real.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If it bothers you that much, why not go see it for yourself?
Everyone turns to look at you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Come on. Eleven, Hypa, you too. Let me show you what DisCity looks like this time of year.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Then... I'm coming too!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Don't you have an exam tomorrow? What's this, O mighty Lady Hella, planning to bring home another big fat zero?
Hella puffs up her cheeks, brimming with sulky displeasure.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You big dummy! Won't even let me have one day off for a trip. You're no fun at all!
You raise an eyebrow at her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Oh, I was going to say... if you guys pass tomorrow, I'd bring you along as a reward. But since I'm such a big no-fun dummy, never mind then...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Huh—wha—wait!! What did you just say?! Hold on, hold on, hold on—don't walk away! You mean it?! Hey! A grown-up can't just say something and take it back—!
But... the renowned garden that greets you upon arrival is a far cry from anything you had pictured.

Gone is the jewel-bright lake from the fairy tale book. In its place sprawls a bog of blackened water, its stench thick and clinging as its viscous pollution oozes into every corner of the forest clearing.
Plants lie dead in wide, rotting patches; animals have fled in droves... You meet the eyes of the two Sinners, each face mirroring the same grim realization: Mania.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What on earth happened here?

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: I remember... some of the listener letters mentioned that The Enchanted Garden used to have a very special quality to it. Quiet, and warm. People really loved that feeling.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: But recently, some listeners have been saying the picture book has changed. The art has grown rough, and the stories feel hollow... Now it all makes sense. The scenery here was being corrupted all along.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: No wonder the listeners were in such low spirits those days. They must have been affected by Mania as well. But I... I didn't know how to comfort them back then.
Eleven lets out a sigh. Hypatia, however, wears a look of earnest contemplation, as if something in Eleven's words has sparked a flicker of inspiration.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Perhaps... this is connected to the garden's current state. It could be that people's negative emotions were projected outward, triggering a Mania overflow. One that not only corrupted the picture book, but bled further into reality.
You're still mulling over her analysis when a startled cry from Hypatia breaks the silence.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Chief, look! Over there—

You follow her gaze. The undergrowth is being steadily corroded by waves of Mania corruption surging forth, and the source spewing all that contamination outward is a fairy-tale picture book, radiating an eerie, unsettling aura.
Quack—

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What is that?!

Was that... a duck quacking? You eye the book with suspicion. Just as you crouch down to examine it more closely, a pink ball comes rocketing out from its pages at tremendous speed and hits you square in the forehead.
The world spins wildly, and then everything goes dark.
As consciousness slowly seeps back, the crisp sound of quacking reaches your ears. A jolt runs through you. You can actually understand what the duck is saying?
...Quack... Quack quack quack... (Oh no, did I just knock all three of them out?)
This has to be a dream... how else could I understand a duck? You close your eyes and try to slip back into the dream.
Quack quack quack quack... Quack quack quack... (Why won't they wake up... Maybe I should try bonking them again...)
Before the duckling can take another shot at your forehead, you struggle to your feet.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: It's okay. It's okay. I'm perfectly capable of waking up on my own, thank you.
You brush the dust from your clothes, rise to your feet, and take in your surroundings. The world has transformed into the pages of a living picture book.

Overhead stretches a sky of soft blue drawing paper, dotted with cotton-ball clouds. The trees are lush with the saturated greens of watercolor brushstrokes, and the windmills carry the folded creases of origami... but at your feet, the flowers lie wilted and shriveled, a stark note of decay in an otherwise painted paradise.

Before you stands, prim and proper, a... duck fairy? Its wings flutter as it quacks at you with great insistence. Your companions groan back to consciousness beside you, and before long, the three of you are locked in a bewildered staring contest with a very determined duck.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Where are we? Why do we look like cartoon characters? And this little duck...

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Our whole style has changed. We look just like cartoon characters from a book... Could it be that we've fallen into that corrupted picture book?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Was it this duck's doing?
Realizing it's under suspicion, the duck hurriedly lets out a flurry of quacks to proclaim its innocence.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Easy now. I don't think it means any harm. It's just talking a mile a minute. We can barely catch a word... Slow down a little. Something about... the garden? And... picture book?
Thrilled that you can actually understand it, the duck grows even more excited. It strains to drag out a hefty book and, using its flat little bill, flips it open before you page by page.

<i><b>Once upon a time, there was a picture book called The Enchanted Garden. Every child who read it and gazed upon its illustrations couldn't help but say: "I wish I could play in that garden someday!" Quack!

<i><b>And from those very wishes, quack—the little duck fairy was born. The more kindhearted wishes people made, the stronger its magic grew. It watched over the world inside the book, and it watched over the real garden too, helping every living thing bloom brighter and more beautiful. Quack!

<i><b>But one day, a book was tainted by something called Mania. The corruption seeped slowly into the fairy tale world. Plants withered and died in great numbers, and worst of all, quack... the little duck fairy's magic began to fade, little by little.

<i><b>It could no longer nurture the flowers, nor bring forth the spring. The garden would never again be what it once was, with every bloom unfurled in full splendor. The readers who came found only disappointment, and little by little, the Mania, driven by that disappointment and malice, fed on their despair and grew ever stronger. Quack...

<i><b>If the Mania at the heart of the fairy tale world cannot be purged, the corruption will spill over and destroy the garden in reality as well. And people may... lose the garden's spring forever. Quack.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So that's why you knocked us into the book? You want us to help you purge the corruption from the fairy tale world?
The duck fairy bobs its head in an eager flurry of nods, its beady little eyes shimmering with a watery, pleading light as they meet yours.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Alright. For the sake of the real world, I'll do everything I can to help you purge the Mania from this storybook.

steps.speaker: Duck Fairy
steps.content: Quack! (Thank you!!!)
